text: Olá, I'm looking after my niece tonight, she's 5, and I need a straight answer because my sister is not picking up the phone, típico. She's got some insect bites, I think maybe mosquitoes or something from the garden, not sure honestly, maybe 4 or 5 of them on her arms and one on her ankle. They are itchy, she keeps scratching, coitadinha, and I told her para de coçar but of course she doesn't listen. That's it really, she ate her dinner, she's in bed now, I think she's fine apart from the itching. What can I put on them? We have some cream in the cupboard but I don't know if it's ok for kids, the label is all small writing. And do I need to do anything else or just leave it until the morning? I don't want to be calling a doctor for nada but I also don't want her up all night scratching. Obrigada.
